description_en: Configures a service address for a specified Smart Access Gateway device
description_zh: 为指定的智能接入网关设备配置服务地址
kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-service-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --address-type ProbeTask --address 192.168.1.1 --sag-id sag-0000 --sn sag0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceAddress

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query region IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~69813~~)接口获取地域ID。
parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The service address type of the Smart Access Gateway instance. Set the value to **ProbeTask**.
